steps.en: Report is created automatically on a schedule
The report covers only non e-payment collections
steps.id: Laporan hanya mencakup koleksi non e-payment
steps.why_en: One report holds all channels; non e-payment is only one tab, and weekly is missing.
steps.why_id: Satu laporan memuat semua channel; non e-payment hanya satu tab, dan weekly tidak ada.

steps.en: Report shows notice, offence time and place, amount, payment date, receipt
steps.id: Laporan memuat notice, waktu dan tempat offence, jumlah, tanggal bayar, receipt
steps.why_en: The offline tab has no offence time or place, only a car park code.
steps.why_id: Tab offline tidak memuat waktu atau tempat offence, hanya kode car park.

steps.en: Excel file is built and attached to an email
steps.id: File Excel dibuat dan dilampirkan ke email

steps.en: The email goes automatically to URA Finance
steps.id: Email terkirim otomatis ke URA Finance
steps.why_en: It goes to 21 named URA staff; nothing shows they are Finance.
steps.why_id: Email ke 21 staf URA bernama; tidak ada bukti mereka bagian Finance.

steps.en: A work item informs the designated officers of the report
steps.id: Work item memberi tahu officer terkait tentang laporan
steps.why_en: Nothing creates a work item; only the email is sent.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item yang dibuat; hanya email yang dikirim.

steps.en: Staff browse non e-payment collections within a chosen date range
steps.id: Staff menelusuri koleksi non e-payment dalam rentang tanggal pilihan
steps.why_en: The staff portal has no screen for browsing these collections by date.
steps.why_id: Portal staff tidak punya layar untuk menelusuri koleksi ini per tanggal.
